annotations.notes: A dog sleeping among shoes was incorrectly described as a cat sitting with a laptop.
Vintage motorcycles were incorrectly identified as bicycles. The model correctly recognized parked two-wheeled vehicles.
A dog lying on a sidewalk beside a bicycle was incorrectly described as sitting on a bench.
A loft bed, desk, and dresser were incorrectly identified as kitchen appliances.
The model correctly identified a giraffe but hallucinated a tree and omitted the second giraffe and human observers.
The model correctly identified the general living-room environment but hallucinated a couch and omitted the woman and chairs.
The model correctly identified birds perched on branches but described only one bird.
The kitchen and microwave were correctly identified. The stove was not clearly visible, and distinctive architectural features were omitted.
The model correctly recognized the baseball context but incorrectly described a player swinging a bat.
The model correctly identified a table containing food but hallucinated a wine glass and omitted the variety of dishes.
